personalizedFeedback.title: Keep The Structure Lean
personalizedFeedback.description: The strongest part of this scan is the bone foundation: fWHR **1.81**, bigonial width **0.919**, and high third scores. Staying lean preserves the jaw and cheekbone definition that makes the face read high-tier.

personalizedFeedback.title: Eye Area Is Already A Strength
personalizedFeedback.description: IPD **0.46**, eye height **0.066**, and brow compactness **0.093** are all excellent. The only practical target is reducing mild under-eye fatigue so the orbital region looks as sharp as the measurements suggest.

personalizedFeedback.title: Lower Third Is The Main Bottleneck
personalizedFeedback.description: Mouth width **0.35** and total lip height **0.093** are the limiting ratios. The structure is strong, but the softer peri-oral area slightly under-supports the jaw width.

personalizedFeedback.title: Nasal Width Is Acceptable But Tight
personalizedFeedback.description: Nose width **0.222** is not a major flaw, but it reads slightly narrow against the broader facial frame. It should be treated as a minor balance note, not the core issue.

personalizedFeedback.title: Why The Score Lands At 82
personalizedFeedback.description: The scan is carried by perfect midface harmony **1.0**, elite skeletal ratios, symmetry, and skin quality. It stops short of the upper 80s because the mouth/lip region is visibly weaker than the surrounding bone structure.
